- **Diff-producer read symmetry (§4 Edit A, assumption A6).** `git diff --name-only HEAD "issue-<N>" -- <paths>` reads from the SAME ref the `git checkout issue-<N> -- <paths>` above WROTE FROM. Per A6 any divergence at this diff is by construction a partial apply. This closes the "wrong-source" class but not the class where `/tmp/issue-<N>-additive-files.txt` itself is truncated or reordered between the checkout and the diff read (both consume the same file, so a truncation is symmetric and reads clean). - **`2>/dev/null` on the diff producer.** The `git diff` producer suppresses stderr — the exit-code arm catches non-zero, but a shell error message that would have named the git failure is discarded. Minor: the terminal `false` still routes to `partial-apply-verify-failed`, so no false `landed` slips through; but a debug read of the sentinel outcome would be more informative if stderr were captured to `/tmp/issue-<N>-postapply-stderr.txt`.
